title: How to install Python libraries in Azure Synapse Notebook Spark Cluster (pyspark)
question:

Any thoughts about what is wrong?

I have tried %pip install fugue, and !pip install fugue, .whl files.
answer:
You can use the commands below:

pip install holidays

pip install fugue
